data.outcome_summary: This OECD note summarizes TALIS 2024 results for Slovenia, focusing on lower secondary teachers and principals. The survey relies solely on self-reports, so the reported indicators reflect perceptions and may be shaped by social and cultural context; the note therefore cautions that cross-country comparisons should be interpreted carefully. The note reports only statistically significant differences or changes relative to an OECD average and highlights that some estimates may be affected by non-response bias. Substantive areas covered include teachers’ background (age, gender, experience), teaching for today’s world (student diversity, special education needs, social and emotional skills), technology use (including AI use), teachers’ learning opportunities (initial teacher education, induction/mentoring, continuous professional learning), teacher leadership/autonomy, professional relationships, status of the profession, employment terms, demands/stress, and teachers’ professional outcomes (e.g., stress, satisfaction, retention intentions). No ML modeling, PV scaling, or missing-data imputation strategy is described in the provided text.
